test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The sun __was shining__ through the window.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e.** 'No improvement'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is already grammatically correct.
 
• The verb **"was shining"** is in the past continuous tense and is appropriate for the context.</li
